**Finding**: Findings #1-6 about `--no-logs-commit`, `ship-pr.md` invariants, `implement-finalize.md`, `test-ship-pr.sh` coverage gaps, `plugin.json` version mismatch, and duplicate ## Goal headers — these are all from the `d5e5dbb` / `89da57f` commits on origin/main (PR #1993 — Bump version to 27.1.0) which appeared in the diff due to our branch's merge-base predating those commits. Not part of our PR.
**Reason not implemented**: All findings are about code from a previously merged PR (#1993), not our 1-line change. Our change adds `export LARCH_TIMING_LEDGER="$TMPDIR/timing-ledger.tsv"` to the codex section of test-launch-review.sh — reviewers confirm no issues with that line.

**Finding**: Finding #1 about bundled run logs and unrelated features — the diff shows many commits from origin/main that are not our change.
**Reason not implemented**: Pre-existing commits from PR #1993 appearing in the diff due to branch merge-base. Finding #2 explicitly says "No correctness defect found in that line" — confirming our change is correct.

**Finding**: All findings about `--no-logs-commit` test coverage gaps in `test-ship-pr.sh` and `ship-pr.md`/`SKILL.md` documentation.
**Reason not implemented**: These are about code from PR #1993 (already merged), not our 1-line timing ledger export. Not part of our change.

**Finding**: All findings about `--no-logs-commit` edge cases in `ship-pr.md`, `SKILL.md`, `rebase-rebump-subprocedure.md`.
**Reason not implemented**: These are about code from PR #1993 (already merged), not our 1-line timing ledger export.
